crossRefs.note: But I am a worm, and no man; a reproach of men, and despised by the people.
You know my reproach, my shame, and my dishonor. My adversaries are all before you.
Reproach has broken my heart, and I am full of heaviness. I looked for some to take pity, but there was none; for…
Remember, Lord, the reproach of your servants, how I bear in my heart the taunts of all the mighty peoples,
With which your enemies have mocked, Yahweh, with which they have mocked the footsteps of your anointed one.
Yahweh, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, says to him whom man despises, to him whom the nation abhors, to a…
Surely he has borne our sickness and carried our suffering; yet we considered him plagued, struck by God, and afflicted.
But he was pierced for our transgressions. He was crushed for our iniquities. The punishment that brought our peace was…
Those who passed by blasphemed him, wagging their heads,
For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”
Others were tried by mocking and scourging, yes, moreover by bonds and imprisonment.
Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
If you are insulted for the name of Christ, you are blessed; because the Spirit of glory and of God rests on you. On…
My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
“An evil disease”, they say, “has afflicted him. Now that he lies he shall rise up no more.”
Yes, my own familiar friend, in whom I trusted, who ate bread with me, has lifted up his heel against me.
You have taken my friends from me. You have made me an abomination to them. I am confined, and I can’t escape.
You have put lover and friend far from me, and my friends into darkness.
“He has put my brothers far from me. My acquaintances are wholly estranged from me.
My relatives have gone away. My familiar friends have forgotten me.
For even your brothers, and the house of your father, even they have dealt treacherously with you! Even they have cried…
For the son dishonors the father, the daughter rises up against her mother, the daughter-in-law against her…
“Brother will deliver up brother to death, and the father his child. Children will rise up against parents, and cause…
You will be hated by all men for my name’s sake, but he who endures to the end will be saved.
Their own tongues shall ruin them. All who see them will shake their heads.
For now you are nothing. You see a terror, and are afraid.
But all this has happened that the Scriptures of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples left him and…
Then he began to curse and to swear, “I don’t know the man!” Immediately the rooster crowed.
At my first defense, no one came to help me, but all left me. May it not be held against them.

translations.web: Because of all my adversaries I have become utterly contemptible to my neighbors, a horror to my acquaintances. Those who saw me on the street fled from me.
translations.bsb: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends— they flee when they see me on the street.
translations.kjv: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled
translations.asv: Because of all mine adversaries I am become a reproach, Yea, unto my neighbors exceedingly, And a fear to mine acquaintance: They that did see me without fled from me.
